entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Ugh, finally. I need to return some shoes. Now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. I can certainly help you with a return. To get started, could I please have your name and order number?
Jane Doe, order number is VF90210. Let's just get to it, can I return them or not? I don't have time for a long call.

Of course, Jane. I'm pulling up your order now. I see the VeloPro cycling shoes. I just need to ask one quick question to process this correctly. Is it a technical fault with the shoes or more of a preference issue?
They don't fit. I've used them a few times and they're giving me terrible blisters. I've adjusted the cleats, I've tried everything. They're just not working for me.

I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just confirm the delivery date... okay, I see they were delivered 77 days ago. That's well within our 90-day return policy.
Great. So you're processing the refund?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return process for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just pack the cycling shoes back in their original box and attach the label. Once our warehouse scans it, the full refund will be credited back to your card.
Okay, that's what I needed to hear. Thank you.

You're welcome. And Jane, I see here that you're a VeloFit VIP member. As a thank you for your loyalty and for the inconvenience with the shoes, I've gone ahead and added a $20 store credit to your account for a future purchase. The email with your label should be in your inbox now.
Oh, a credit? That's actually very helpful. Appreciate that. That's all I need.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for being a VeloFit VIP, and have a great rest of your day.
